activation_requirements: Create the public Gist from the repository ICLA and metadata payload.
Install and link the hosted CLA Assistant GitHub App.
Observe a successful license/cla status on the migration pull request.
Replace the pending Gist fields with the live URL, ID, and revision before merge.
Create a dedicated default-branch CLA ruleset requiring license/cla and pin the expected source to CLA Assistant.
Preserve the existing baseline ruleset unchanged and without bypass actors.
Leave the CLA ruleset without bypass actors unless the documented Entity CLA process is activated.
Export the hosted signature register to private storage and record the export date.
